ConnectionStrings._comment: Set ConnectionStrings__NpgsqlConnection env var with your PostgreSQL connection string.

_comment_connection_token: HMAC key MUST be set via connection_token_keys database table. Keys must never appear in appsettings.json.
_comment_key_id: KeyId MUST be set via connection_token_keys database table.

ForwardedHeaders._comment: Required in Production: without KnownProxies/KnownNetworks the host refuses to start. NGINX on this host connects from loopback.
